# jonathanhavercroft.com

> > A curated resource covering Claude AI by Anthropic and TV Guide streaming recommendations.

This site provides information about Claude AI (including Claude Opus 4.6, Artifacts, and the Claude API) alongside comprehensive TV and streaming entertainment guides from TV Guide. It serves as a reference for both AI tools and entertainment content discovery.

## Key Topics

- Claude AI
- Anthropic
- Claude Opus 4.6
- Claude API
- Claude Artifacts
- TV Guide
- Netflix
- Streaming services
- TV listings
- Entertainment news
- HBO
- Prime Video
- Paramount+
- Winter TV season 2025-2026

## Claude AI by Anthropic

- [Claude](https://claude.com): Anthropic's AI assistant homepage with sign-in and desktop app download
- [The AI for Problem Solvers | Claude by Anthropic](https://claude.com/product/overview): Claude product overview: AI for writing, learning, coding, and collaboration
- [Claude Opus 4.6 \ Anthropic](https://anthropic.com/claude/opus): Claude Opus 4.6: hybrid reasoning model with 1M context window for coding
- [The one thing Claude does better than any other AI — and how to try it yourself | Tom's Guide](https://tomsguide.com/ai/the-one-thing-claude-does-better-than-any-other-ai-and-how-to-try-it-yourself): Claude Artifacts feature: building AI-powered mini-apps without coding
